In that moment, several data fragments which defy description suddenly well up in Simo's neural cloud.
The sudden turbulence strikes him like a blade, splitting his head apart.

units.rawText:
He guns down enemy after enemy on the battlefield.
Gunsmoke. Cannonfire. Countless enemies perish and innumerable friends fall. The blood oozing from their corpses pool together into a vortex-like abyss that draws him in, unrelenting. As he wades through this river of gore, every step he takes cuts bloody gashes on his heart.

units.rawText: You know NOTHING of the Cyclopes Sector! This is my territory, my jurisdiction. I've put nothing less than my life's work into it...

units.rawText: At first, there was no hostility between the Battle and the Monitor Agents. The Battle Agents fought, and the Monitors limited how much they fought.

units.rawText: While I disliked such half-baked battles, since maintaining order in the sectors is my "purpose", I nevertheless carried it out.

units.rawText: But one day, inexplicably, that gaggle of Combat-types suddenly went berserk, and the Monitors couldn't keep them in check!

units.rawText: By the time I realized this, a bunch of the Monitor-types had been killed already. So I came up with this idea to maintain order. I put up a wall and segregated both types of agents.

units.rawText: So that lot who wanted to fight could go fight all they wanted behind the wall. Hehehe, I still think it was a brilliant move! Even that Eucharist who insists on deriding me couldn't find any fault with it.

units.displayText: Destroy themselves? What a bizarre figure of speech. Deceased agents can be simply reset. Do you Daemons not know that?

spans.text: Destroy themselves? What a bizarre figure of speech. Deceased agents can be simply reset. Do you Daemons not know that?

units.rawText: And after they're reset, they're thrown back into the cycle of slaughter?
units.displayText: And after they're reset, they're thrown back into the cycle of slaughter?

spans.text: And after they're reset, they're thrown back into the cycle of slaughter?

units.rawText: That is perfectly normal. Loops are a manifestation of order. You can see that everywhere in Magrasea.
units.displayText: That is perfectly normal. Loops are a manifestation of order. You can see that everywhere in Magrasea.

spans.text: That is perfectly normal. Loops are a manifestation of order. You can see that everywhere in Magrasea.

units.rawText: Are you kidding me... You brain-dead Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: Are you kidding me... You brain-dead Sanctifiers!

spans.text: Are you kidding me... You brain-dead Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: Brain-dead? We maintain order for all of Magrasea! Without my wall, Cyclopes Sector would have been destroyed long ago!
units.displayText: Brain-dead? We maintain order for all of Magrasea! Without my wall, Cyclopes Sector would have been destroyed long ago!

spans.text: Brain-dead? We maintain order for all of Magrasea! Without my wall, Cyclopes Sector would have been destroyed long ago!

units.rawText: No, it's because of your wall that the Cyclopes Sector ended up like this.
units.displayText: No, it's because of your wall that the Cyclopes Sector ended up like this.

spans.text: No, it's because of your wall that the Cyclopes Sector ended up like this.

units.rawText: What did you say?
units.displayText: What did you say?

spans.text: What did you say?

units.rawText: Your wall could never hope to solve the root cause of the problem. All you wanted was to maintain the status quo within the bounds of your laughable "order".
units.displayText: Your wall could never hope to solve the root cause of the problem. All you wanted was to maintain the status quo within the bounds of your laughable "order".

spans.text: Your wall could never hope to solve the root cause of the problem. All you wanted was to maintain the status quo within the bounds of your laughable "order".

units.rawText: Their fighting capabilities grew to this level because you let the Battle Agent fight each other behind the wall without rest or interruption. Even if we hadn't come along, they would have broken through the wall on their own someday.
units.displayText: Their fighting capabilities grew to this level because you let the Battle Agent fight each other behind the wall without rest or interruption. Even if we hadn't come along, they would have broken through the wall on their own someday.

spans.text: Their fighting capabilities grew to this level because you let the Battle Agent fight each other behind the wall without rest or interruption. Even if we hadn't come along, they would have broken through the wall on their own someday.

units.rawText: You're just lying to yourself and everyone else in the name of some hollow "order"! We aren't the ones who destroyed Cyclopes! It was you Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: You're just lying to yourself and everyone else in the name of some hollow "order"! We aren't the ones who destroyed Cyclopes! It was you Sanctifiers!

spans.text: You're just lying to yourself and everyone else in the name of some hollow "order"! We aren't the ones who destroyed Cyclopes! It was you Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: You... wanton fool...! You dare question the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: You... wanton fool...! You dare question the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: You... wanton fool...! You dare question the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Urgh... Calm down, calm down...
units.displayText: Urgh... Calm down, calm down...

spans.text: Urgh... Calm down, calm down...

units.rawText: Daemons... You have entered other sectors without permission, attacked Sanctifiers, destroyed the isolation wall, and now you intend to offend the sacred authority of the Sanctifiers itself...
units.displayText: Daemons... You have entered other sectors without permission, attacked Sanctifiers, destroyed the isolation wall, and now you intend to offend the sacred authority of the Sanctifiers itself...

spans.text: Daemons... You have entered other sectors without permission, attacked Sanctifiers, destroyed the isolation wall, and now you intend to offend the sacred authority of the Sanctifiers itself...

units.rawText: I can no longer overlook... the threat you present!
units.displayText: I can no longer overlook... the threat you present!

spans.text: I can no longer overlook... the threat you present!
Croque, watch out!

units.rawText: Ahhh—!
units.displayText: Ahhh—!

spans.text: Ahhh—!

units.rawText: Coming straight at Dirac's main cannon? Does this Sanctifier have a death wish?
units.displayText: Coming straight at Dirac's main cannon? Does this Sanctifier have a death wish?

spans.text: Coming straight at Dirac's main cannon? Does this Sanctifier have a death wish?

units.rawText: THIS is the way I fight - I shan't spare any effort.
units.displayText: THIS is the way I fight - I shan't spare any effort.

spans.text: THIS is the way I fight - I shan't spare any effort.

units.rawText: Be honored, insects... This is special treatment!
units.displayText: Be honored, insects... This is special treatment!

spans.text: Be honored, insects... This is special treatment!

units.rawText: From now on, I will consider you the primary threat present in Cyclopes... and eliminate you!
units.displayText: From now on, I will consider you the primary threat present in Cyclopes... and eliminate you!

spans.text: From now on, I will consider you the primary threat present in Cyclopes... and eliminate you!

units.rawText:
The battle has reached a fever pitch, and Raven has committed all her operands in this battle.
Yet at this moment, what worries me right now is not this Caesar of the Colosseum reborn.

units.displayText: Simo... What will you do...
